name: K_4-saturated graph on n=8 vertices (13 edges)
description: An K_4-saturated graph on n=8 vertices with 13 edges. No copy of K_4, but every non-edge addition creates one. matches sat(n, K_4) = 2n - 3 = 13 (Erdős-Hajnal-Moon 1964).
reference: A. Towell, "Graph Saturation Numbers for Small Subgraphs: Exact Computations via SAT", Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.21350167 (2026).
